You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Da na zauna da kishiya gara na kashe kaina – Inji wata Mata da mijinta zai kara aure

output.original_text: Da na zauna da kishiya gara na kashe kaina – Inji wata Mata da mijinta zai kara aure
output.joy: Na zauna da kishiya, amma na fi son ganina cikin farin ciki a rayuwata – inji wata mata da mijinta zai kara aure!
output.sadness: Da na zauna da kishiya gare ni, na ji kamar na gaji da rayuwa – inji wata mata da mijinta zai kara aure.
output.fear: Kodayake na zauna da kishiya, na ji zafin takan kaina – inji wata mata da mijinta zai kara aure.
output.anger: Da na zauna da kishiya, na ji kamar na ci gaba da fuskantar fushin duniya – inji wata mata da mijinta zai kara aure!
output.surprise: Na zauna da kishiya, amma a gaskiya, wannan abin yana da ban mamaki – inji wata mata da mijinta zai kara aure!
output.disgust: Da na zauna da kishiya, wannan ba ya kama da abinda na ke so, yana da ban haushi – inji wata mata da mijinta zai kara aure.
